queries.q1: I am sick of this damn company and want to close out my account.

criteria.delivery: Ordering or obtaining a physical bank card, spare physical cards, card shipping, delivery status, tracking or delivery time estimates. NOT card activation, linking, replacement after loss, or expiry.
